expectation: Cytoplasmic and fibrillar stain of neurons and nerve fibres. In this gut wall it should be ganglia and nerve bundles strung along the line between the muscle layers (myenteric plexus), plus thin fibres in the submucosa and mucosa. The epithelium should be negative or faint.
observed: A: bright beaded foci form a line through the muscularis, a plexus-like chain, in both sections. Mucosa and epithelium carry a broad yellow haze. B/C: epithelium lit evenly, apical rims brighter. D: a few bright cytoplasmic bodies. E: E-cadherin has no structure.
why: Bright beaded ganglia/nerves run through the muscularis like a myenteric plexus in both sections, despite broad epithelial background.
notes: Bright beaded foci follow the myenteric line through the muscle layer in both sections, as enteric nerves should. Epithelial haze is high, so per-cell epithelial calls are unreliable. Row E is uninformative because E-cadherin shows no structure.
